whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Ayaan's Cafe & Restaurant,

I noticed your cafe has built a strong following with over 300+ reviews in Bihta, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for online table bookings and food menu viewing.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, digital food menu, aur special dish highlights integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/ayaans

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Ayaan's Cafe & Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Ayaan's Cafe & Restaurant) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? 

Great! We tailored it specifically with a digital menu display, table booking via WhatsApp, and a clean mobile-first layout suited for customers in Bihta. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual food photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
